data.narrative:
Physical Intelligence, a Series B AI & Software company founded by Karol Hausman, Sergey Levine, Chelsea Finn, and Brian Ichter, is valued at $5.6B post-money after raising $600M+. The peer universe consists of 9 comparables—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private firms in the AI & Software sector at similar stages, including Scale AI, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies $10.6B from the $5.6B last post-money. Peer-median methodology across three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $3.2B, though the peer range is wide ($2.0B to $29.0B), reflecting heterogeneity in the AI sector. Scale AI at $29.0B represents an outlier premium; Black Forest Labs and Field AI anchor the lower end at $3.2B and $2.0B respectively.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $2.8B (low) to $12.2B (high), with a median of $6.9B. The target's current $5.6B valuation sits within this range, slightly below the median. Key uncertainties include the appropriate peer set given extreme variance in AI sector Stage B valuations, the applicability of stage-progression multiples in a volatile frontier-tech environment, and whether outliers like Scale AI reflect market reality or represent isolated outliers. The wide peer dispersion ($2.0B–$29.0B) limits confidence in median-based conclusions.
